# ButtonSize

`Flare.Components.ButtonSize`

Size of a FlareButton on the shared Xs..Xl scale (Md is the default).

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Xs` | `0` | Extra small |
| `Sm` | `1` | Small |
| `Md` | `2` | Medium |
| `Lg` | `3` | Large |
| `Xl` | `4` | Extra large |
